```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot to visualize survival based on passenger class and gender
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='pclass', hue='sex', palette='pastel')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Count of Passengers', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=10, loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
